entries.title: The Mahler conjectures and symplectic width
entries.summary: Resolves the symmetric and nonsymmetric geometric Mahler conjectures in every dimension, with Hanner polytopes and simplices as the respective volume-product minimizers and all equality cases classified. The corresponding sharp functional Mahler inequalities also hold. For , every symmetric polar product in dimension has Gromov width .

entries.summary: Constructs a finitely presented torsion-free group whose group algebra has nonzero zero divisors, disproving Kaplansky's zero-divisor conjecture. The group has a finite two-dimensional classifying space.

entries.summary: Proves Kadison's similarity conjecture: every bounded complex-linear unital algebra homomorphism from a unital complex -algebra to operators on a Hilbert space becomes a -homomorphism after conjugation by a bounded invertible operator.

entries.summary: Disproves Kaplansky's quasitrace conjecture by constructing a separable unital complex -algebra admitting normalized -quasitraces, all of which are nonadditive. entries.title: The Kadison–Ringrose cohomology conjecture
entries.summary: Proves that every bounded Hochschild cocycle of degree at least two on a complex von Neumann algebra, with coefficients in the algebra itself, has a bounded primitive. Equivalently, all higher bounded Hochschild cohomology groups vanish, resolving the Kadison–Ringrose conjecture.

entries.title: Hyperbolicity cones without semidefinite lifts
entries.summary: Disproves the Projected Lax conjecture: some hyperbolicity cones are not spectrahedral shadows. The examples admit no exact finite affine semidefinite lift, regardless of the number of auxiliary variables or the real coefficients used. This also disproves the generalized Lax conjecture that every hyperbolicity cone is spectrahedral.

entries.title: The 2-to-1 Games Conjecture with perfect completeness
entries.summary: Proves Khot's 2-to-1 Games Conjecture with perfect completeness: for every fixed rational , it is NP-hard to distinguish satisfiable games from games whose optimum is at most , on explicit unweighted instances. The alphabet depends only on , and every right-hand label has exactly two preimages under each constraint map.

entries.title: Hardness of coloring three-colorable graphs
entries.summary: It is NP-hard to color a three-colorable graph using any fixed number of colors. More strongly, for every fixed , a deterministic polynomial-time reduction from SAT produces simple unweighted graphs that are three-colorable in the satisfiable case and have no independent set of size otherwise, where is the number of vertices.

entries.title: Uniform sparsest cut: hardness and semidefinite gaps
entries.summary: Proves that approximating Uniform Sparsest Cut within any fixed constant factor is NP-hard, even with nonnegative rational capacities and unit demands. The Goemans–Linial semidefinite relaxation also has integrality gaps of order at least , approaching the square-root-logarithmic upper bound.

entries.title: Unbounded bin-packing gaps and the modified integer round-up conjecture
entries.summary: Disproves the modified integer round-up conjecture of Scheithauer and Terno: the integral bin-packing optimum can exceed its configuration linear-programming value by an arbitrarily large additive constant. Approximating the optimum within any fixed additive constant is also NP-hard, even when every item exceeds and each bin holds at most five items.

entries.title: Exponential semidefinite complexity of perfect matching
entries.summary: Proves that every exact semidefinite lift of the perfect matching polytope has exponential size, answering Rothvoss's polynomial-size lift question negatively. The bound holds even for the positive semidefinite rank of its odd-cut slack matrix after any fixed shift , allowing arbitrary real positive semidefinite factors.

entries.summary: Resolves the Erd s–Pomerance joint Dickman conjecture: the logarithmic sizes of the largest prime factors of and are asymptotically independent in ordinary natural density. In particular, the integers satisfying have density .

entries.title: Positive lower density of large prime gaps
entries.summary: For every fixed , a positive proportion of consecutive prime gaps exceed , throughout every sufficiently large initial segment of the primes. The proportion may depend on . Consequently, the indices where increases have positive lower density, answering Erd s and Prachar.

entries.title: Deterministic polynomial factorization over prime fields
entries.summary: Gives a uniform deterministic algorithm that completely factors every nonzero dense degree- polynomial over a prime field , including multiplicities, in bit complexity polynomial in . The prime is supplied in binary. No randomness, integer-factorization or primitive-root oracle, or GRH assumption is required.

entries.title: The full Birch–Swinnerton-Dyer formula in Selmer coranks zero and one
entries.summary: Proves the full Birch–Swinnerton-Dyer leading-term formula for every elliptic curve over whose full -power Selmer group has corank zero or one for some prime , including finiteness of the Tate–Shafarevich group. With result 006, this gives full BSD for a density-one set of quadratic twists of every elliptic curve over .

entries.title: The quasi-Riemann hypothesis
entries.summary: Proves that every Dirichlet L-function, including ζ(s), is zero-free in Re(s) > 7/8, resolving the quasi-Riemann hypothesis. The same half-plane is zero-free for every finite-order Hecke L-function over . A companion gives a different proof of the zero-free half-plane Re(s) > 11/12.
